description: This file provides helper functions to convert between ADODB recordset objects and XMLRPC values, including functions to build XMLRPC structs from recordsets and vice versa, with some handling of recordset metadata and data extraction.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: A class representing the metadata of a database field, used when reconstructing recordsets from XMLRPC data.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array
classes.description: A class representing an in-memory recordset built from an array of data and field definitions.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval
methods.description: Converts an ADO recordset object into an XMLRPC struct value, containing header and body.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval_header
methods.description: Builds an XMLRPC struct representing the header information (metadata) of an ADO recordset, including field info and counts.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcval_body
methods.description: Builds an XMLRPC struct representing the data rows of an ADO recordset.

methods.name: rs2xmlrpcstring
methods.description: Serializes an ADO recordset into its XMLRPC string representation.

methods.name: xmlrpcval2rs
methods.description: Creates an ADO recordset object from an XMLRPC struct value, parsing metadata and data.
